mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate level inversely correlates with equity valuation multiples; lower rates compress discount rates and boost S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as monetary policy accommodates growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5%, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals labor market deterioration and reduced consumer spending capacity, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as earnings growth expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5, or the Rank IC for UNRATE as a predictor falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate revenue growth prospects deteriorate.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
